description: Compare a gross annual salary with the country and sector benchmark, returning whether it is below, near, or above the benchmark and by what percentage.

country.description: Country code, e.g. USA, UK, DE, EE (see list_options)

salary.description: Gross annual salary in the country's local currency

sector.description: Sector code, e.g. it, finance, national (see list_options)

name: compare_salary
title: Compare a salary to a benchmark
